ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio defined by a dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) ventral background and numerous high-intensity (white) circular pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Multiple high-contrast white ring-shaped (annular) blobs and solid white spots scattered across the medial and lateral regions of both fluke lobes against a solid dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 70 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; notable macro-level jagged indentations on the upper-left margin and tattered, irregular distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward convex trajectory of the trailing edges, terminating in highly irregular, non-linear distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of white, circular pixel clusters (rosette scars) concentrated in the central-lateral zones of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions observed on the lower-left lobe segment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged, irregular distal tips on both lobes representing cumulative physical trauma; visible calcified clusters (barnacles) attached to the far-left and far-right lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive cluster of overlapping white ring-shaped marks on the right lobe forming a unique geometric pattern.
